finding.text: Every shot is a 404: the only page in the diff (`run-1/readmes-page/`, a one-line `TaskPage`) is not on the main site yet. The branch `task/process-system` is not merged and the site serves the main tree. So "visible on the session page" (requirement 3) has no proof, and none of the page systems can be judged. shots/…/sheet.png, all four widths: "Page Load Error", "404 — nothing matches". Re-shoot after the merge, or shoot it from a served worktree.

Nothing in the diff changes `TaskView` or `TaskPage`. A process shows on the session page only as a plain Task with subtasks. The phase's session, its pulses and its cost (`measure` lines) are written to the file but not drawn anywhere. requirements.md §3 asks only for "whatever shows today", so this is a note, not a fix.

process.md's own "Still open" line: the answer to the creating `item` call carries the instructions for the parent's class, not for the new process. That is a small trap for the next agent that creates a process.

"Investigate" exists as its own definition. It does not run as build's first phase yet: phases cannot nest, and parallel scouts are not built. process.md lists both under ⬜ Next, so this is an honest gap, not a hidden one.
